| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Wavelet** `wavelet` | Daubechies 4 (db4) | Haar, Daubechies 2 (db2), Daubechies 4 (db4), Daubechies 8 (db8), Symlet 4 (sym4), Symlet 8 (sym8), Coiflet 1 (coif1), Coiflet 3 (coif3) | The orthogonal wavelet. Its filter taps come from PyWavelets. |
| **Levels** `levels` | 4 | 1 to 8 | How many times the transform splits the low-pass part. It is capped at the deepest level the image size allows. |
| **Window** `window` | Smallest of 3x3 to 9x9 | Smallest of 3x3 to 9x9, 3 x 3, 5 x 5, 7 x 7, 9 x 9 | The square neighborhood of coefficients that estimates the local signal variance. The first option computes it for 3x3, 5x5, 7x7 and 9x9 and keeps the smallest estimate. |
| **Noise sigma** `sigma` | 0 | 0 to 100 | The standard deviation of the noise, in pixel values. 0 estimates it from the finest diagonal details. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Brightness only, Color only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
